title: austrostipa aphylla
intro: Austrostipa aphylla, commonly known as needle grass, is a species of grass native to Australia. This plant is valued for its traditional use in Aboriginal medicine, where it is believed to possess various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Austrostipa aphylla include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its potential health benefits.
